resources.string: Your sessions on the home screen
Add the widget to see which sessions are running and which ones you used last, without opening the app. Tap a session to jump straight in, or start a new one.
A home screen with the OpenCode widget listing two running sessions and a recent one. After a refresh, one of the sessions is no longer running.
Open any file the agent touched
Tap the open button on a read, write or edit row, or on a changed file, to read the whole file with syntax highlighting. It is read-only, so nothing changes by accident.
In the chat, a tool row for a file has an open button. Tapping it opens the file with line numbers and highlighted code.
A full terminal in your pocket
Open a shell on the server, in your session's folder, from the chat top bar. A key bar gives you Esc, Tab, Ctrl and the arrows that phone keyboards lack.
A terminal where the command npm test is typed. Tapping Enter on the key bar runs it and the test results appear.
Read what the agent remembers
When a long conversation is compacted, tap the Context compacted divider to read the summary the agent keeps going with.
In a transcript, the Context compacted divider is tapped and opens to show the summary of the conversation.
Talk to your agent
Tap the microphone next to the message box and just speak: your words appear in the prompt as you say them. Tap again to stop, then review and send.
The microphone button is tapped and starts listening. The sentence Add a dark mode toggle to the settings screen is written into the message box word by word, then the microphone is tapped again.
See where your tokens and money go
The Usage screen in Settings shows cost, prompts, tokens and your busiest models for today, the last 7 days or the last 30 days.
The Usage screen. Switching from Today to 7 days makes the cost and token totals grow and fills the chart of steps per day, with the models used below.
Only the notifications you want
In Settings, under Session notifications, pick which kinds to get: permission requests, questions from the agent, or finished sessions.
Three switches under Session notifications. Questions and Finished sessions are switched off, Permission requests stays on.
